name: status-button
title: Status Button
description: A button that folds into a spinner while it works, then opens in green with a traced check, or shakes in red.

perf.budget: Width, colour and icon animations are springs and timings on the UI thread; the spinner's frame callback runs only while loading.

a11y.reducedMotion: States switch with a short fade: no width spring, spinning or shake.
a11y.screenReader: Button role; its name follows the state (label, 'in progress', success or error label) and is announced politely. Busy while loading.
a11y.touchTarget: 52 pt tall; at least 52 pt wide while loading.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add status-button`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
